stem: A scout sees silvery leaf scarring and dark fecal specks, then dislodges several slender insects from the affected tissue. What should the record say?
choices: A nutrient deficiency is confirmed because silvering is a mineral symptom.
Spider mites are confirmed because fecal specks are diagnostic of mites.
Thrips are strongly supported by the combined organism and feeding evidence, but species-level identity should remain bounded by the available identification method.
The crop is pest-free because the insects were easy to dislodge.
rationale: Silvery or scarred tissue, dark fecal specks and recovered slender insects support a thrips workup, while species-level identification can require expert microscopic examination.
